Josiah Henson, Father Henson’s Story of His Own Life.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/josiah-henson/father-hensons-story-of-his-own-life

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Josiah Henson, the author, died 1883.
- Harriet Beecher Stowe, the writer of the preface, died 1896.

First publication of the text used: 1858 (SE colophon: 'Father Henson’s Story of His Own Life was published in 1858 by Josiah Henson.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1858, before 1931; a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so this work entered it in 1953.
- Country of origin: every person whose words are in the text died in 1896 or earlier (the last to die, Harriet Beecher Stowe, in 1896), so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
